description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, rear and side roof extensions with two front and one rear roof light, and removal of rear chimney stack.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:001, 002, 100, 110, 200, 201, 202 Received 12 October 2023; 203, 210, 211, 212 Received 05 December 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.5 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.
Condition : 5 - The windows to be fitted on the front roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
